text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-ME-8732 fired for eng-oncall — severity=P2 — reason=ModelCatalog: tokenizer mismatch detected for model redwood-qa (rev=2024-11-03_3f2a). Auto-created incident #inc-2445. Link: https://pd.company/pd-incidents/PD-ME-8732

PagerDuty: Auto-acknowledging page will escalate in 3m if not acknowledged by a human.

Alice N.: acked oncall (Alice N.) — taking lead. probing logs now.

Ben C.: seeing spike in tokenizer-exception metrics starting ~04:11Z. quick grep from runtime logs:
```
2026-03-14T04:11:12Z ERROR tokenizer mismatch: expected=hf/bert-tokenizer-v1 actual=hf/gpt-tokenizer-v2 model=redwood-qa rev=2024-11-03_3f2a request_id=abc123
2026-03-14T04:11:13Z WARN decode-failure truncated output len=0 model=redwood-qa rev=2024-11-03_3f2a
```
Looks like catalog promoted rev 3f2a which has wrong tokenizer metadata.

Priya (oncall): confirming — catalog change log shows promotion at 04:09Z by automation pipeline (catalog-promote job). Promotion metadata: user=ci-bot, source=staging->prod, rev=2024-11-03_3f2a.

SRE Lead: initial customer impact estimate?

Support Ops: two customer tickets flagged as "responses garbled / truncated" — customers: corp-acme (EU-WEST), fintech-blue (EU-WEST). Both on premium SLAs. Ticket IDs: #SUP-912, #SUP-913. Not wide yet but critical tenants affected.

Alice N.: mitigation plan: 1) rollback catalog default for redwood-qa to previous known-good rev 2024-10-28_9c1b 2) add runtime guard to reject configs without tokenizer field 3) notify support + customers. Starting rollback now.

Ben C.: suggested rollback command (catalogctl):
```
catalogctl promote --model redwood-qa --rev 2024-10-28_9c1b --env prod --reason "rollback after tokenizer mismatch" --force
```

Priya (oncall): executing rollback (running catalogctl). Will watch router health and tokenizers metrics.

Ops Bot: catalogctl: promotion job started (job_id=prom-789). check logs: https://internal/logs/prom-789

Ben C.: routing note — traffic is gradually moved via simple-weighted routing; keep canary window open 1m to ensure no regression.

Alice N.: PagerDuty: acknowledging page and setting responder to Alice N. at 04:13Z.

PagerDuty: Acknowledged by Alice N. — escalation stopped.

Support Ops: pinging account execs for corp-acme and fintech-blue. Drafting small incident email.

SRE Lead: while rollback running, gate runtime to validate tokenizer metadata — quick hotfix patch example to run in prod agents:
```
# pseudo-config check on model load
if not model_cfg.metadata.get('tokenizer'):
  reject_deploy("missing tokenizer metadata")
```
Apply as a reversible feature flag.

Priya (oncall): rollback job completed at 04:16Z — promoted rev 2024-10-28_9c1b as default. Router reports steady success rates.

Ben C.: metrics: tokenizer-error-rate dropped from 12.3% -> 0.8% across prod region eu-west in 2 minutes. latency unchanged.

Support Ops: customers notified: corp-acme acknowledged, fintech-blue reports normal now. Both tickets updated with mitigation details.

Alice N.: opening follow-up tasks: 1) audit catalog promotion pipeline (why automation promoted wrong rev) 2) add pre-promotion validation that compares tokenizer id vs model artifact 3) post-incident review scheduled. Assigning owners.

SRE Lead: escalating to infra team for pipeline check — @Ben C. you own the pipeline debug, @Alice N. coordinate postmortem.

Ben C.: quick findings — automation picked latest build artifact but missing migration that pins tokenizer metadata; reproducer locally. creating PR: https://git.internal/r/catalog/PR-452 (WIP).

Priya (oncall): handing off active monitoring to Ben C. for next 2 hours. My shift ending in 20m. No further PD escalations expected.

Alice N.: summarizing customer impact: 2 premium customers affected for ~5 minutes, no data exfil, degraded output only. SLA impact: none (no downtime) but customer experience regression.

SRE Lead: action items + priorities captured. Recommend marking incident as "resolved" in PD once oncall confirms 15m stable window.

Ops Bot: Incident #inc-2445 status -> resolved candidate. uptime checks green.

Ben C.: will keep an eye on tokenizer error metric for 30m then close. handing off to follow-up doc: https://wiki.internal/incidents/2445

Alice N.: thanks all, nice fast rollback. :thumbsup:

Support Ops: will send short RCA to customers after postmortem.

Priya (oncall): leaving note for next oncall: watch for suspicious catalog promotions from ci-bot user and any automation without validation.

Ben C.: closing thread, marking last check-in 04:22Z — metrics stable.

IncidentBot: Incident #inc-2445 auto-closed after 10m stable state.
